US strikes five Iranian oil tankers after IRGC targets Navy warship twice, escalating conflict again

The United States destroyed five Iranian crude oil tankers on Tuesday September 8, after Iran's Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) targeted a US Navy warship twice with ballistic missiles over two days, US Central Command (CENTCOM) said.
OpenAI is spurring an under-the-radar run in SoftBank as well as chip stocks

OpenAI's new LLM is inciting enthusiasm and spilling over to the company's customers and suppliers. The launch of OpenAI's latest frontier algorithm is making waves on Wall Street and triggering a run in stocks that are tied to CEO Sam Altman's company.

Oil surges as Brent crude nears critical $100 mark amid escalation in West Asia

Brent crude oil approached the $100 per barrel mark following the US military's attack on Iranian tankers near the crucial crude-export hub of Kharg Island, raising concerns about potential further disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz.
All about the IPO bonanza on Dalal Street

Not one, not two, but as many as 10 mainboard IPOs will be open for subscription at the same time on Wednesday, September 9. From Rentomojo to Asset Reconstruction, LCC Projects, Pranav Constructions, among others will be vying for investor attention at the same time.
Coforge shares in focus after resignation of Chairman Om Prakash Bhatt

Coforge Ltd shares are in focus on Wednesday, September 9, 2026, after its chairman and independent director Om Prakash Bhatt (OP Bhatt) resigned, before the completion of his term. The resignation is effective from today itself.
Explained - Why the Dow Jones fell over 600 points on Tuesday but S&P 500 and Nasdaq did not

A major reason behind the fall on Wall Street were the escalating tensions in West Asia and the subsequent impact on crude oil prices. Another reason behind the sell-off on Wall Street is the rising trade tensions between the US and Canada.
China's inflation rises for first time since April; higher food and fuel prices put pressure on pockets

China's consumer inflation has increased for the first time since April, and factory-gate prices have risen more than anticipated, driven by higher food and energy costs that are rekindling inflationary pressures.
Here's why Graphite India shares may see a reaction on Wednesday

Shares of Graphite India Ltd. are in focus on Wednesday, September 9, on the back of the GrafTech International's stock rising 15% overnight on the Wall Street. GrafTech International shares surged after the company announced a minimum 30% increase in graphite electrode prices.
NSE IPO price band likely to be between ₹1,750 - ₹1,785 per share, sources say

The National Stock Exchange (NSE) is likely to set the price band of its upcoming IPO between ₹1,750 to ₹1,785 per share, sources in the know told CNBC-TV18. At the upper end of the likely price band, NSE is likely to command a valuation of ₹4.41 lakh crore, the sources added.
9 of world’s 10 least climate resilient cities are in South Asia; 5 in Pakistan alone

Nine of the world’s 10 cities with the lowest resilience scores have been located in the Indian subcontinent, covering India, Pakistan and Bangladesh, according to a new report. AlphaGeo’s report. The report looked at six major dangers.
PM Modi at GFF calls for Fintech Consumer Protection Index, wider play and stronger cybersecurity

Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Tuesday called on India’s fintech industry to move beyond payments and expand its footprint across credit, insurance, savings, investments and pensions, saying the next phase of growth must replicate the “speed and scale” achieved by UPI.
